chunks: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity and do not take a life which Allah has forbidden except for a right, and do not commit fornication — and whoever does that will meet the penalty of sin,

key_terms.يَلْ أَثَامًا: will meet the penalty of sin

ai.seo_question: What are the three major sins mentioned in Surah Al-Furqan that define the servants of Allah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited as a foundational text for the 'Abd al-Rahman' (Servants of the Merciful), linking moral purity directly to spiritual proximity to God. The prohibitions against idolatry, unjust killing, and fornication are viewed not merely as legal restrictions but as essential markers of the faithful's character, with the 'burden' (itham) implying a compounding of sins that affects both the individual and the community.
